title: Huh? (Dog)
blurb: Canine confusion, considerably more emotionally involved than its feline equivalent. Where the huh cat is merely baffled, the huh dog is personally concerned about what you have just said and would like to help, if only it could work out the problem. One species is bewildered; the other is worried about you. Play it for statements that require a double-take: sudden plans, weird requests, arithmetic performed out loud. The confusion is mutual and completely sincere, and adorable in a way the cat version never quite manages.
